rules.templates.title.t9.text: Avoid stops inside a detected liquidity cluster

rules.templates.title.t10.text: Reduce leverage when funding exceeds a threshold

rules.templates.title.t12.text: Re-arm chase when the book thins

rules.templates.sentence.t1.text: When the position changes on BTCUSDT (Main), if unrealised R is at least 1.0: move the stop to break-even (your average entry) plus 2 ticks. Once per position. The stop only ever tightens.

rules.templates.sentence.t2.text: When a 1m bar closes on BTCUSDT (Main), if a position is open: tighten the stop to 2.0 × ATR(14) from the close. The stop only ever tightens.

rules.templates.sentence.t3.text: When a 5m bar closes on BTCUSDT (Main), if the position is long: tighten the stop to 10 ticks below the last swing low. The stop only ever tightens.

rules.templates.sentence.t4.text: Three rules, one per rung: When the position changes on BTCUSDT (Main), if unrealised R is at least 1.0: scale out 33 % at market. Once per position.

rules.templates.sentence.t5.text: Every 60 s on BTCUSDT (Main), if the position is older than 30 min and unrealised R is below 0.2: flatten the position and tag the journal time-stop. Once per position.

rules.templates.sentence.t6.text: When the book updates on BTCUSDT (Main), if the spread is above 8 bps: cancel every working entry order. At most every 60 s.

rules.templates.sentence.t7.text: When a position closes on Main, if today's loss is at least 2 % of equity: halt new orders on this account until the next UTC day and notify me (push, high).

rules.templates.sentence.t8.text: When a trade prints on BTCUSDT (Main), if tape speed is above 3 sigma: halt new orders on this account for 5 min — illustrative: the duration has no field yet (G6). At most every 5 min.

rules.templates.sentence.t9.text: When a 1m bar closes on BTCUSDT (Main), if the nearest liquidity cluster is at most 5 ticks from the price and the position is long: tighten the stop to 10 ticks from the price. The stop only ever tightens.

rules.templates.sentence.t10.text: When the funding rate changes on BTCUSDT (Main), if funding is above 0.05 %: reduce leverage to 5×. Once per day.

rules.templates.sentence.t11.text: Every 60 s on BTCUSDT (Main), if funding settles within 5 min and a position is open: flatten the position. Once per day.

rules.templates.sentence.t12.text: When the book updates on BTCUSDT (Main), if either book pressure is below −0.5 or liquidity was pulled: arm the chase limit. At most every 30 s.

rules.templates.example.t1.text: at 64,000 entry and 63,900 stop, 1R is reached at 64,100 — the stop moves to 64,000.20

rules.templates.example.t2.text: close 64,200, ATR(14) 45 → the stop moves to 64,110 if that is tighter

rules.templates.example.t3.text: swing low 63,950 → the stop moves to 63,949

rules.templates.example.t5.text: opened 13:10 UTC, at 13:41 UTC with unrealised R 0.1 the position is flattened

rules.templates.example.t6.text: spread 9 bps → every working entry order is cancelled

rules.templates.example.t7.text: equity 10,000 USDT, today's loss 210 USDT → new orders halted until 00:00 UTC

rules.templates.example.t8.text: tape speed 3.4 sigma at 13:42:10 UTC → halted until 13:47:10 UTC

rules.templates.example.t9.text: price 64,000, cluster 4 ticks below → the stop moves to 63,999 if that is tighter

rules.templates.example.t11.text: funding at 16:00 UTC → the position is flattened from 15:55 UTC

rules.templates.example.t12.text: book pressure −0.6 → the chase limit is armed
